title: 124's SoulCraft
description: A mod about soul and weapons made of soul.I  hope it can help you.Made of MCreator.
body:
The Mod's goul is to help players to face strong mobs and makes their playing easlier.It provides weapon can grow,so that it can accompany with players until the end of their journey instead of always replace their weapons.It also provides some way to get resourses.It is made by Mcreator.
## A mod about soul
The Mod create a new capibility named Soul.Most of its content is about it.It needs gotten by using the key to soul.
## Weapon Growth
We can use soul to make soul weapons.They can grow by killing mobs and improving your soul.So the can be used through your journey.
## Different skills
All of the soul weapons have different skills.Their attecking is also has different attributes.
## More lives
When you have a soul in your bag.It has same effect as the Totem of Undying.
### How to play the mod
You need to make the Slipt Soul.A weapon can slipt soul pieces from the mobs or other players.Than you can use soul pieces to make the key to soul.After using it,you can get the Soul capibility and you can also use Slipt Soul to slipt your own empty soul.All the soul weapons is made from empty soul and other materials.
